items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-21
items.q: a few pieces that we played in there with Buddy P. D. like, uh, Maverly Prahm.

ctx.x: Uh huh. But I was lucky, like, a few pieces that we played in there with Buddy P. D. like, uh, Maverly Prahm. So he had to switch his corner to a low key. And that would make a lot of fellas couldn't cross. But I would look at a few pieces that we played in there with Buddy P. D. like, uh, uh, and then he would come in. Maple Leaf Rag. Those kind of numbers. I'd push my car like he would, but I had to play in a different key. See the trumpet, if he's playing in the key of Bb, I'm playing the same key as the…
You played, um, that number, whatever you said, in A's?
